data.name: Mahera
data.gender_notes: Mahera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahera is an elegant Arabic name meaning 'expert' or 'skilled'. It symbolizes talent, intelligence, and mastery in various fields. The name Mahera carries the meaning “Expert, Skilled, Talented” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Mahera usually hope their child will grow to embody expert, skilled, talented and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents divine wisdom and the mastery of skills through patience and dedication.
data.etymology: Mahera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Expert, Skilled, Talented.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahera total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مُهِرَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُهِرَة، من أصولٍ عربية، تعني "الجمال" و"القوة" و"الإشراق". تُنسب إلى "الهر","هُرّة" التي تعني "الزهرة" أو "العمارة"، مشيرة إلى جمالها وازدهارها. لا توجد إشارة مباشرة لها في القرآن الكريم، لكنها تحمل دلالات إيجابية في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: مہِرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہِرہ ایک عربی اصطلاح ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے “خوبصورتی، طاقت اور روشنی”. یہ “ہر” کے الفاظ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا معنی “پھول” یا “عمارت” ہے۔ یہ اردو میں بہت مقبول نام ہے، خاص طور پر اسلامی برادری میں۔ یہ دکھاتا ہے کہ انسان خوبصورتی اور روشنی سے بھرا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: महेरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: महेरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'सुंदरता, शक्ति और चमक'. यह 'हर' शब्द से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'पंख' या 'भवन'. यह हिंदी में भी लोकप्रिय नाम है, खासकर मुस्लिम समुदाय में। यह नाम एक शक्तिशाली और सुंदर व्यक्ति की छवि प्रस्तुत करता है।

in_pashto.name: مېره
in_pashto.long_meaning: مېره یه پښتو نوم دی چې معنی يې جلال، جمال او نور دی. د «هَر» لفظې له کې راځي، چې معنا يې «گل» یان «عماري» ده. د اسلامي نړۍ کې يې په ډېرې توګه کارول کېږي، په خصوص په افغانستان کې.

in_english.name: Mahera
in_english.long_meaning: Mahera is an Arabic name meaning 'beauty, radiance, and brilliance'. Derived from the root word 'har', which signifies 'flower' or 'building', it evokes imagery of blossoming beauty and prosperity. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, Mahera carries positive connotations in Islamic culture, symbolizing feminine grace, light, and inner strength. It is a popular name across Muslim communities globally.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ: مېره (mehr-eh)

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahera represents a woman of substance and capability, who is accomplished and proficient in her chosen field. It conveys a sense of pride and respect for the individual's skills and abilities, which is highly valued in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mahera reflects the belief in the inherent potential and worth of each individual. It encourages self-improvement and the pursuit of knowledge and mastery, as a way to honor the divine gift of God-given talents and abilities. The name also reinforces the idea that every person has a unique role to play in society, and that using one's gifts to serve others and make a positive impact on the world is an important part of living a meaningful and purposeful life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mahera: The Radiant and Shining One. Her light illuminates the path for seekers of truth and guidance.
